name: Jesse Lee Davalos
bio:
Jesse Lee Davalos is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in the 'newschool' style, bringing vibrant and modern designs to life with confidence and creativity. With top-notch professionalism, Jesse maintains a high standard of service, ensuring that each client's experience is seamless from the initial consultation to the final touch of ink. To book an appointment and embark on your next tattoo journey with Jesse, reach out at tattoojesse1994@gmail.com – please note that the studio observes a $200 minimum for all sessions.
